mainCause: GUIToScreenPoint applies the current GUI scale but adds nested native ScrollView group origins without scaling them. Registered card-body bounds are below the screen and intersect to zero height, so native touch has no scroll candidate and the overlapping card button activates.

fixReview.rounding: Round combined native scroll and viewRect offset per axis before adding correction
fixReview.identity: Child viewport key stays independent of its own scroll; parent identity distinguishes equal semantic content
fixReview.assumptionChecked: Current nested managed scrollers contain no intervening unmanaged GUI.BeginGroup or GUI.matrix mutation
fixReview.diagnostics: Native input exists and follows the full swipe; touch tracking never begins because child bounds are empty. Event-only and delayed-input fixes are separate edge-case protections.
